expo.name: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify
expo.description: Modern stock verification system for Lavanya Mart inventory management

infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify needs access to devices and services on your local network to connect to the backend.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify uses the camera to scan item barcodes, serial numbers, and capture stock evidence photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify may use the microphone only when a camera capture mode records video with audio.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify can access selected photos when you attach evidence images to stock records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify can save captured evidence photos when you choose to export or save them.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify uses Face ID to unlock the app when biometric authentication is enabled.

plugins.cameraPermissionText: Lavanya Mart Stock Verify uses the camera to scan item barcodes, serial numbers, and capture stock evidence photos.
